message.content: Before I start a task: the shop should tell people about their orders. Customers get an e-mail when an order is paid or shipped, staff see new orders without reloading the page, and customers can turn the e-mails off.

content.text: What the code has today: src/payment.js:4 charge() returns status 'paid', the place a "paid" e-mail would start from. Nothing in src/ sends e-mail or tracks shipping (src/auth.js:3 only keeps a reset token against an e-mail address). Which mail server should send them?

message.content: Our company SMTP server, no new mail service account. And the texts in English only for now: the shop has no other language.

content.text: Noted: mail goes through the company's SMTP server (no new account), texts in English only (the shop has no other language). Still open: how staff see new orders, a browser push or a counter on the staff page?
